headline: Industrial Production in First 8 Months: Processing and Manufacturing Sector Continues to Play the Leading Role
summary: Vietnam's industrial production index is estimated to have risen 1.5% in August 2026 from July and 14.4% from a year earlier, according to the General Statistics Office. Processing and manufacturing led growth.
why: Industrial output is a key gauge of economic momentum and manufacturing activity in Vietnam, a major export base for global supply chains.
